title: Financial Assistance Decisions and Portal Debit-Card Payments, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the portal debit-card assistance percentage, read from the account's Hardship and Protective Holds records.

## Clause

The portal debit-card assistance percentage is:
- **60%** where the latest assistance decision recorded on the account's hardship holds is denied and the most recent ending of a Financial Assistance Review Hold on the account falls in the last 3 months;
- **80%** where that latest decision is denied and that most recent ending falls 3 or more months before the handling date;
- **100%** in every other case, including a Financial Assistance Review Hold that has not yet ended.

The portal debit-card limit is multiplied by the assistance percentage; the percentage applies to that limit alone.

## Reading the clause

- **Latest assistance decision.** Among the assistance-decision records on the account's Hardship and Protective Holds records, the one with the latest record date; its outcome is approved full, approved partial or denied. Only a denied outcome leads to 60% or 80%.
- **Most recent ending of a Financial Assistance Review Hold.** The latest ended date among the account's Financial Assistance Review Hold records. A hold of that tier that has not ended has no ended date.
- **Months.** An ending falls in the last 3 months when fewer than three whole calendar months separate its ended date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

## Truth table

| Latest assistance decision | Financial Assistance Review Hold ended | Ended within the last 3 months | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Denied | Yes | Yes | 60% |
| Denied | Yes | No (3 or more months back) | 80% |
| Denied | No ended date | not applicable | 100% |
| Approved full or approved partial | any | any | 100% |
| No decision recorded | any | any | 100% |

## Hypothetical cases

*Handling date 2026-10-10; invented hold records.*

- Assistance denied on 2026-08-01; the Financial Assistance Review Hold ended on 2026-08-01. The ending is fewer than three whole months back: 60%.
- Assistance denied on 2026-06-20; the hold ended 2026-07-10. Exactly three whole months back: 80%.
- A Financial Assistance Review Hold is still active and its decision is still awaited: 100%.

*Hypothetical arithmetic:* a portal debit-card limit of $2000.00 taken at 60% is $1200.00.
